segment_description: High-spend one-time buyers whose typical last purchase is at or past the inactivity threshold - previously valuable, now slipping away.
recommended_strategy: Targeted win-back in the original category with a personalised incentive capped by expected value; prioritise the high-value-at-risk list (top-20 % spenders still inside the threshold); measure reactivation against a hold-out group.

segment_description: One low-value purchase; the typical member is at or past the inactivity threshold.
recommended_strategy: Low-cost reactivation (newsletter, seasonal campaigns such as Black Friday).

segment_description: Recently acquired (last ~3 months), one purchase, typical basket.
recommended_strategy: Onboarding journey and second-purchase incentive inside the 0-90 day window where most second purchases happen; ensure the first delivery is on time.

segment_description: Customers with two or more delivered orders - the only group with proven repeat behaviour.
recommended_strategy: Membership / loyalty points on the 2nd-to-3rd order, category cross-sell based on their history, review-request after on-time delivery.
